atlas-au.0072: Australian firms hire graduates through structured graduate programmes that recruit in the penultimate or final year of study, often after a summer internship over the December–February holidays; the public service runs its own graduate intakes.
atlas-au.0073: International graduates find it much harder: in business, 53.3% of international postgraduates were in full-time work against 92.2% of domestic ones.
atlas-au.0075: In the 2026 AAGE surveys 97% of organisations offered a graduate programme; employers offered an average of 52 graduate roles each, while applications per employer rose 23%, and 28% of graduates applied for 20 or more roles.
atlas-au.0076: Entry is for final-year students and recent graduates: Macquarie’s graduate programme (12 to 24 months, February 2027 start) took applications from 21 September to 13 October 2026 from students in their final year or within 12 months of finishing, and KPMG’s 2027 programme asks for a five-minute form, then online assessments, with a pay band of A$60,000 to 80,000 shown.
atlas-au.0078: 67% of organisations offer an intern or vacation programme, and 50% of graduates begin their job search before their final year. Macquarie’s summer internship runs 10 to 12 weeks from December to January for students in their penultimate year and can be fast-tracked into its graduate programme.
atlas-au.0079: Internship applications rose 9.4% per employer on 2024, so the internship round is itself competitive.
